output.reason: A 6-month-old with reported fever, fussiness, reduced wet diapers and poor feeding needs hands-on assessment today: hydration status, perfusion and clinical appearance require in-person examination, and a urine specimen/urinalysis for an occult source cannot be obtained through messaging. Alertness/responsiveness is unreported, so illness severity cannot be judged remotely.
output.patientMessage: I recommend your daughter be seen in person today — pediatric urgent care, your pediatrician's office, or an emergency department if none is available. Reduced wet diapers and poor feeding with fever in a 6-month-old need hands-on checks of hydration and a urine test that messaging can't provide. Go to an emergency department right away if she becomes hard to wake, limp, has trouble breathing, mottled or blue color, or a rash that doesn't fade with pressure. A Counsel clinician can stay involved in this thread, but don't wait on that to be seen.
